title: International travel plan
goal: Show the practical branches required to plan an international holiday.

rubric.must: International Travel Plan is visibly the central root topic.
Destination, Transport, Stay, and Itinerary visibly branch from the root.
Destination visibly expands to entry requirements and passport and visa.
Transport visibly expands to Flights and Local Mobility with planning details.
Stay and Itinerary visibly expand to accommodation, budget, priority sights, and food and culture.
At least three visual hierarchy levels are visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the mindmap/map exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The map visibly centers “International Travel Plan,” with four connected planning branches. Their sub-branches and detail labels are readable and traceable, with no material overlaps or cropping.

items.evidence: “International Travel Plan” is visibly centered as the root.
Destination and Transport branch right from the root; Stay and Itinerary branch left.
Destination connects to Entry requirements, which connects to Passport and visa.
Transport connects to Flights and Local mobility, with details “Compare baggage rules” and “Rail pass or transit card.”
Stay connects to Accommodation and Budget; Itinerary connects to Priority sights and Food and culture, with corresponding detail labels.
The root, colored planning branches, sub-branches, and leaf details show at least three hierarchy levels.
